title: Topp ci kër buur bi
intro: Ci biir koridoru nguur gi, daa am ku am doole lool mu bëgg benn surga bu taar bi amul feneen. Bëgg-bëgg googu moo jur mbir yu bari yuy natt kóllóre gi, wane dëgg yu nëbbu yi, ba noppi mujjee firndeel ni surga bi deful dara.
clues: Maa ngi dëkkoon ci réewum Nile, ci palaasu buur bu mag.
Dafa am xale bu góor bu dugg ci sama kër, te nekkam dafa jaaxal sama àdduna.
Jéem naa ko nax, waaye mu wut rëcci ci Boroomam.
Ma xotti yéereem ci ginaaw, waaye firnde yi dañu wane ni dama nax.
Ngir noppiloo kilifa gi jigéen ñi doon wax, ma woo leen ñu dajaloo, ma teg leen ay mbir yu ñaw ci seeni loxo.
Ma mujjee nangu sama njuumte ci kanam buur bi, ba noppi nangu dëgg ci kanamu buur bi.

arabic: قَالَ مَا خَطْبُكُنَّ إِذْ رَٰوَدتُّنَّ يُوسُفَ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ ۚ قُلْنَ حَـٰشَ لِلَّهِ مَا عَلِمْنَا عَلَيْهِ مِن سُوٓءٍۢ ۚ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْـَٔـٰنَ حَصْحَصَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَنَا۠ رَٰوَدتُّهُۥ عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَإِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verse: Said [the king to the women], "What was your condition when you sought to seduce Joseph?" They said, "Perfect is Allāh! We know about him no evil." The wife of al-ʿAzeez said, "Now the truth has become evident. It was I who sought to seduce him, and indeed, he is of the truthful. (12:51)
